    if c in cols:
        print("Column conflict")
        break
    cols.add(c)

    print("Columns OK")

# Check diagonals
diag1 = set()
diag2 = set()
for r, c in enumerate(board):
    d1 = r - c
    d2 = r + c
    if d1 in diag1:
        print(f"Diagonal1 conflict at row {r}, col {c}")
        break
    if d2 in diag2:
        print(f"Diagonal2 conflict at row {r}, col {c}")
        break
    diag1.add(d1)
    diag2.add(d2)
